Why Tava Labs Makes One Daily Face Serum
Tava Labs makes one product, the PDRN Brightening Serum, a daily face serum. This article explains why we made one serum instead of many products and what is in it.
Why Tava Labs Makes One Daily Face Serum
Tava Labs started with one simple idea. People notice skin that looks healthy, rested, and hydrated.

Healthy looking skin is not about buying expensive products or using many products. Skin that looks rested and hydrated is what people notice first when they meet you, see you in a pitch meeting, or see your photograph.
One product, used every day

Many skincare brands sell many products. We made one. The PDRN Brightening Serum is one bottle of face serum, 1 fl oz, which is 30 ml. It contains PDRN and a peptide to support skin that looks bright and firm, and sodium hyaluronate, glycerin, and sodium PCA to add water to the skin, and panthenol to keep skin comfortable. You apply it in two minutes, twice a day.
Using one product every day works better than using ten products only once in a while. Skin changes slowly and builds over time with regular use.
Where Tava Labs started

Tava Labs began with sleep tracking, because a short night of sleep shows on your face the next day. The serum came from the same idea. Measure what matters, use the smallest routine that helps, and keep track of it. The Tava app holds your plan, your daily record, and your reminders in one place, and lab results will be added there soon.
What we will never do

We will not invent reviews, promise results we cannot prove, or sell you twelve products. We make one serum, we publish every ingredient in it, and we tell you to judge it by using it every day as directed.

That is why Tava Labs sells one product. The PDRN Brightening Serum is a daily face serum for founders, entrepreneurs, and business owners who pitch, present, and record video. It costs $49 for one bottle or $39 a month on subscription.
